description:
## Goal
The stack bead `<prefix>-phase-<x>.stack` exists for every phase as the ledger and the lock of its stack, poured with the phase root and required by `validate-plan`; the pour writes branch, worktree, pr_target and difficulty onto every bead of a sprint family; a pydantic model per bead kind with one validation over every bead of the phase fails the pour on any missing value. Governing text: `docs/requirements/sanity-stack.md` 1 and 2, `team-lead.md` 13, 43, atm-bd-orchestration #340. Anchors: ANC-067, ANC-078..083.

## Deliverables
1. `templates/stack-bead.json.j2` (skills/atm-beads): one bead per stack, id `<prefix>-phase-<x>.stack`, `issue_type` task, child of the phase root, labels `phase-<x>`, `stage:stack`, metadata `trunk` (the root's `integration_branch`), `stack_number` (null until the first link) and `layers` (empty list). `resources/planning.md` lists it beside `plan-root.json.j2` as rendered with the root into the plan JSONL; the lead creates it by importing that plan JSONL, never by a hand-written `bd create` (team-lead 13; this is the lead creation sanity-stack 1 and task-close-hook 20 name).
2. Layer record: each `layers` entry is `{branch, pr, head, base, linked}`; the last entry is the top; `layers` is the only record of layer order (ANC-067). `bead_schema.py` carries the `StackBead` model with `trunk`, `layers` and the entry model; the claim and the compare-and-set release are plain `bd` commands documented in `resources/orchestrating.md` ("Stack bead": `bd update <stack bead> --claim`; release `bd update <stack bead> --if-assignee "$ATM_IDENTITY" --status open --assignee ""`; the claim's 900 s lease is kept by `bd heartbeat`; an abandoned claim of this stack bead is recovered only with `bd reclaim --id <stack bead> --older-than 1800s`, then `layers` is re-derived from the hosted stack when the ledger disagrees; unscoped `bd reclaim` and event-age-as-lease-expiry are forbidden; ANC-068's claim timeout is the waiting rule, reclaim the abandoned-holder rule), used by sanity-stack (bj-3) and the lead.
3. `validate-plan`: problem 6, the stack bead is missing, is not a child of the root, or its `metadata.trunk` differs from the root's `integration_branch`; `--file` mode accepts the rendered stack bead in the file. Problem 6 applies to a phase whose root is open; a closed root is not checked; the problem line names the fix (render `stack-bead.json.j2` with the root vars and `bd import` it), so an open older phase gains the bead the same way.
4. Pour metadata (#340 item 1): the producers are `formulas/sprint-group.formula.toml.j2` and `formulas/finding-group.formula.toml.j2`; at pour time every generated dev, fix, sanity and QA bead receives `branch`, `worktree`, `pr_target` and `difficulty`: `bead-groups` copies the sprint container's values onto the sprint group's dev, sanity and qa beads (ANC-078..081). `templates/qa-bead.json.j2` (the QA bead the lead creates for a finding or a quick fix) requires `branch`, `worktree` and `pr_target` from the cut layer it checks and writes all four keys, so it passes the same `stage:qa` model. Beads poured for a blocking finding (the fix group) carry the same four keys from the layer cut (#340 item 2); `assignment-gates.py` is not edited here (its readers already expect the keys on the bead).
5. One model per bead kind (#340 item 3): sprint container, dev, sanity, qa (with `checked_bead` and the round), gate, finding, fix, stack, and the sanity and qa children of a finding or fix; each names its required metadata keys; `extra="allow"` stays. `bead_schema.py validate --phase <x>` walks every bead under the phase epic (`bd list -l phase-<x> -n 0 --json`, never `--all`), picks the model from the `stage:*` label, including `stage:dev` (the root by its id, a gate by `issue_type` gate); a bead with no model is itself a problem (`<bead>: no model`), so the walk skips none (ANC-083); it exits non-zero naming each bead and missing key (#340 item 4). `bead-groups` validates the exact rendered prospective records together with every current phase bead before any persistent attach/write: missing metadata on an existing or prospective bead makes zero mutating calls and leaves the database unchanged; `--validate` uses the same preview path; tests use real sc-compose-rendered records and injected failures. `schemas/*.schema.json` re-exported.
6. `templates/dev-fix.xml.j2` and `examples/dev-fix-vars.json` deleted; `phase-config init` no longer writes `dev_fix` and `validate-plan`/`plan_contract.py` accept a phase file without it (a sanity FAIL reopens the bead in place on the same task; nothing re-assigns a dev after a FAIL: task-close-hook.md 15). Existing phase files that still carry `dev_fix` stay valid: the key is ignored, not existence-checked. Closed sweep, in this layer: `sprint_index_common.py` (`DEFAULT_TEMPLATES` and docstring), `skills/atm-beads/tests/phase_fixtures.py`, `resources/planning.md` and `resources/orchestrating.md`, `skills/atm-bd-orchestration/SKILL.md` (the template-key list, the `test_command`/`lint_command` rows, the sanity-finding routing row, the template table), the `dev-complete.md.j2` description, the dev-fix cases of `test_templates.py`, the `dev_fix` entry in the package `README.md` `[templates]` key list, and the generated manifest/registry blocks re-run by `tests/gen_manifest.py`; `CHANGELOG.md` history and `config/legacy-owned.json` stay.
7. Tests: `bead_schema.py` model per kind with fixtures mirroring live ids (`atm-bi-7`, `atm-bi-7.group-sanity`, `atm-phase-bi.15-sanity`, `atm-phase-bi.18-qa`, a stack bead), the validate walk, `validate-plan` problem 6 and `--file` with the stack bead, `bead-groups` writing the four keys onto dev, sanity and qa beads and failing the pour on a model error.

## Required Work
- The phase-bi live beads are the fixture source: copy their JSON shapes into the tests, do not invent fields.

## This Sprint Does Not Close
- Reading `metadata.layers` in bj-1’s close hook or writing layer updates under the claim in bj-3; this sprint ships the schema, the pour and validation.
- The console dispatch reading the poured keys (atm-core atm-phase-bi.18, phase-bi).

## Public Contract
`templates/stack-bead.json.j2`:
```json
{"id": "<prefix>-phase-<x>.stack", "title": "phase-<x>: stack", "issue_type": "task", "status": "open",
 "labels": ["phase-<x>", "stage:stack"],
 "dependencies": [{"issue_id": "<prefix>-phase-<x>.stack", "depends_on_id": "<prefix>-phase-<x>", "type": "parent-child"}],
 "metadata": {"phase": "<x>", "trunk": "integrate/phase-<x>", "stack_number": null, "layers": []}}
```
`bead_schema.py`:
```python
class LayerRecord(BaseModel):
    branch: str; pr: int; head: str; base: str; linked: bool
class StackMetadata(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="allow")
    trunk: str; stack_number: int | None; layers: list[LayerRecord]
class FamilyMetadata(BaseModel):          # dev, fix, sanity, qa (poured or from qa-bead.json.j2); finding keeps its own keys
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="allow")
    branch: str; worktree: str; pr_target: str; difficulty: Literal["hard", "normal", "fast"]
MODELS_BY_STAGE = {"stage:sprint": SprintBead, "stage:dev": DevBead, "stage:dev-sanity": SanityBead, "stage:qa": QaBead, "stage:fix": FixBead,
                   "stage:finding": FindingBead, "stage:stack": StackBead,
                   "stage:plan": Bead, "stage:plan-review": Bead, "stage:review": Bead}
# the root is matched by id (RootBead: integration_branch), a gate by issue_type gate (GateBead);
# the sanity and qa children of a finding or fix carry stage:dev-sanity / stage:qa; anything else -> "<bead>: no model"
def validate_phase(beads: list[dict]) -> list[str]: ...   # "<bead>: <missing key>" per problem
```
`bead_schema.py validate --phase <x>` exit 0 valid, 5 problems listed, 2 cannot run.

## Exact Targets
- new `skills/atm-beads/templates/stack-bead.json.j2`
- edited `skills/atm-beads/scripts/bead_schema.py`, `validate-plan`, `phase-config`, `plan_contract.py`, `resources/planning.md`, `resources/orchestrating.md`, `schemas/*.schema.json`, `skills/atm-bd-orchestration/scripts/bead-groups`, `formulas/sprint-group.formula.toml.j2`, `formulas/finding-group.formula.toml.j2`, `templates/qa-bead.json.j2`, `sprint_index_common.py`, `skills/atm-bd-orchestration/SKILL.md`, the `dev-complete.md.j2` description, `skills/atm-beads/tests/`, `skills/atm-bd-orchestration/scripts/tests/` (`test_bead_groups.py`, the dev-fix cases of `test_templates.py`), the generated blocks of `manifest.yaml` and `registry.yaml`
- deleted `skills/atm-bd-orchestration/templates/dev-fix.xml.j2`, `examples/dev-fix-vars.json`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] (ANC-067) rendering `stack-bead.json.j2` with the phase-bj root vars gives id `atm-phase-bj.stack`, parent `atm-phase-bj`, `metadata.trunk` `integrate/phase-bj`, `layers` `[]`; `validate-plan --file <plan.jsonl> --phase bj --index docs/plans/phase-bj.jsonl` exits 5 naming the stack bead when it is left out of the file and 0 when it is present; in `skills/atm-beads/tests/test_validate_plan.py` a fixture phase with a closed root and no stack bead exits 0.
- [ ] (ANC-067) `StackMetadata` rejects a layer entry missing any of `branch`, `pr`, `head`, `base`, `linked`; the test fixture with two layers reads the top as `layers[-1]`.
- [ ] (ANC-083) sc-compose-generated sprint-group and finding-group formula records in a scratch bd database: `bd show <id>.group-dev --json`, `bd show <id>.group-sanity --json` and `bd show <id>.group-qa --json` each carry `branch`, `worktree`, `pr_target` and `difficulty` equal to the container's; the fix group of a blocking finding carries the same four keys from the recorded layer cut.
- [ ] (ANC-083) `bead_schema.py validate --phase <x>` over a phase with one sanity bead stripped of `branch` exits 5 with the line `<bead>: branch`; `bead-groups` on the same input exits non-zero and pours nothing new; a fixture bead under the epic with an unknown `stage:*` label gives `<bead>: no model`; a `qa-bead.json.j2` render validates as `stage:qa`.
- [ ] (task-close-hook.md 15) `phase-config init` writes six template keys and a phase file carrying `dev_fix` still validates.
- [ ] `python3 skills/atm-beads/scripts/bead_schema.py export schemas` reproduces the committed schemas byte for byte.

## Validation
- `just lint` and `just test` in the atm-bd-orchestration worktree.
- `.claude/skills/atm-beads/scripts/validate-plan --ci` in atm-core after the skill install (every tracked phase file still parses without `dev_fix`).
